title: oven-baked light polish turkey paella
description: a creamy, mustardy polish dish featuring turkey and served in a paella pan

ingredients.name: saffron threads
ingredients.amount: 1 teaspoon, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water

instructions: heat the olive oil in the paella pan over medium-high heat.
add the diced onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it's lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
add the ground turkey and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it's no longer pink, about 5-7 minutes.
stir in the chicken broth, heavy cream, saffron threads with their liquid, dijon mustard, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
bring the mixture to a simmer, then transfer the paella pan to the preheated oven.
bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
remove the paella pan from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
serve immediately, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or chives if desired.
